findings.desc: Docs lane blocker: linked roadmap/operator docs still contain stale pre-B-e781 wording that says M4-M12 remain follow-up/current future work. The main roadmap now shows B-e781 closure and parent_roadmap_status confirms all M4-M12 rows closed with command-backed local evidence, but docs/guide-scope-guard.md:8 says `M4-M12 remain follow-up milestones`, docs/guide-scope-guard.md:13 says unrelated runtime features `remain follow-up work`, and docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md:27 repeats `M4-M12 remain follow-up milestones`. Update these docs to reflect B-e781 closure with evidence commands/claim boundaries while keeping Authority Server conformance retired/non-goal.

packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:2219 and packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:2232 still describe storyId B-43de as mapping to the migration diagnostic sample, but packages/main/src/handlers/parent-roadmap.ts:33 now routes B-43de to buildParentRoadmapSampleCase("b-43de"). Runtime check with node bin/lattice.js parent_roadmap_status storyId=B-43de returns full_roadmap_complete, while case=migration remains migration_needed. The stale help/schema wording undermines the scope acknowledgement and claim-boundary update by telling operators the old behavior.
